metadata.guidance_markdown:
## Part 1: Security questions

Your answers must be the same as what you told us on your online claim. You will need the following information to hand:

* claim reference number
* National Insurance number

## Part 2: Amendment section

Only answer a question if you need to change what you submitted in your online claim.

Leave questions blank that you do not want to change.

Use this section to give us the correct information for your:

* gross weekly rate of pay
* employment start and end date
* the date your notice was given

These are the only details you can update, which we use to calculate your claim.

what_happens_next.name: What Happens Next
what_happens_next.message:
We will update your claim with the new information you provided. 

We aim to do this within 10 working days. After we have updated your information, we will let you know if you are due a payment. 

You do not need to send us any further evidence to complete your application.

If you have not had a response from us within 15 working days, contact us at: [redundancypaymentsonline@insolvency.gov.uk](mailto:redundancypaymentsonline@insolvency.gov.uk)

Make sure you tell the insolvency practitioner handling your employer’s insolvency about any changes you make to your claim. They may need to update the information they provide to the Insolvency Service.

To make another amendment to your redundancy claim, complete the relevant form from the [redundancy claim amendment forms](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/amend-a-redundancy-claim) page.
